biological.citation: Inhibition of lactylation by LRP1 expression increases the risk of intervertebral disc degeneration: A multi-omics summary-based Mendelian randomization analysis (PMID: 40988222)
biological.summary: H2AC6 was identified as a lactylation-related gene positively correlated with increased risk of intervertebral disc degeneration (IVDD) at the gene expression level through multi-omics summary-based Mendelian randomization analysis combining GWAS, eQTL, and mQTL data.
biological.sample_size: FinnGen GWAS cohort with eQTLGen and SMR mQTL data

biological.citation: Global comparative transcriptomes uncover novel and population-specific gene expression in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (PMID: 37641095)
biological.summary: H2AC6 was identified as a novel differentially expressed gene critical for esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) survival through comparative transcriptomic analysis across six global populations and survival analysis using TCGA data.
biological.sample_size: ESCC samples from six distinct global populations; TCGA dataset
biological.significance: Identified through survival analysis as critical for ESCC prognosis

biological.citation: Tribulus terrestris L. protects glomerular endothelial cells via the miR155-H2AC6 interaction network in hypertensive renal injury (PMID: 34926670)
biological.summary: H2AC6 (H2A clustered histone 6) was identified as a target of miR-155-5p in a miRNA-mRNA regulatory network protecting against angiotensin II-induced hypertensive renal injury; miR-155-5p expression was negatively correlated with H2AC6 expression.
biological.significance: miR-155-5p and H2AC6 identified as core components of protective network; validated by qRT-PCR

biological.citation: Unveiling the Therapeutic Potential of Baicalin in Intervertebral Disc Degeneration: Integrative Bulk and Single-Cell Transcriptome Analysis with Experimental Validation of PANoptosis Inhibition (PMID: 40463856)
biological.summary: H2AC6 was identified as one of five core PANoptosis-related genes significantly upregulated in degenerated intervertebral discs; baicalin treatment downregulated H2AC6 expression at both mRNA and protein levels in IL-1β-induced nucleus pulposus cell degeneration models.
biological.sample_size: Clinical disc samples; IL-1β-induced NPC model; rat puncture-induced IVDD model
biological.significance: Significantly upregulated in degenerated discs; downregulated by baicalin treatment

biological.citation: Serum extracellular vesicle RNA profiles in long COVID: insights from exercise-induced gene modulation (PMID: 41588020)
biological.summary: H2AC6 was identified as one of the top 5 downregulated genes in serum extracellular vesicles at peak exercise following 10-week exercise training in long COVID patients, suggesting modulation of H2AC6 expression in response to exercise-induced physiological adaptation.
biological.significance: q < 0.05; among top 5 downregulated genes post-training at peak exercise
